title: Infrastructure: setup.sh, Cargo.toml, build.rs, .gitignore
description:
Create the test crate skeleton: Cargo.toml, build.rs, setup.sh, .gitignore, testvectors/nist/ inline hex files, and tests/common.rs.

## What
One-time infrastructure bead that must land before any test file can compile.

## Algorithm
1. Write Cargo.toml: name=wolfssl-rust-test, edition=2021, wolfssl-wolfcrypt path dep on ../wolfssl/wrapper/rust/wolfssl-wolfcrypt with features [rand_core,aead,cipher,digest,signature,mac,kem,password-hash]; deps: hex=0.4, serde_json=1; dev-deps: aead={version=0.5,features=[dev]}, digest={version=0.11,features=[dev,mac]}, cipher=0.5.
2. Write setup.sh (chmod +x): set -euo pipefail; idempotent: skip if dir already exists; clone --depth 1 https://github.com/wolfSSL/wychcheck external/wychcheck; clone --depth 1 https://github.com/google/wycheproof external/wycheproof. Record the actual HEAD commit of each clone to audit/vector_commits.txt for reproducibility.
3. Write .gitignore: /external/  /target/
4. Write testvectors/nist/aes_38a.rs: pub const structs/arrays of hex!() literals from NIST SP 800-38A Appendix F. Cover ECB/CBC/CTR/OFB, key sizes 128/192/256, encrypt+decrypt directions (24 vector sets, ~4 block pairs each).
5. Write testvectors/nist/cmac_38b.rs: pub const arrays from NIST SP 800-38B Appendix D.1-D.3. Cover AES-128/192/256, 4 message lengths each (12 vectors total).
6. Write testvectors/nist/sha_inline.rs: 1-2 NIST FIPS 180-4/202 example pairs per algorithm (SHA-1/224/256/384/512, SHA3-224/256/384/512, SHAKE128/256).
7. Write tests/common.rs: wolfcrypt_init()/wolfcrypt_cleanup() call wrappers (panic on error); load_wycheproof_json(path: &str) -> serde_json::Value helper; assert_at_boundary() for key material never appearing in format strings.
8. Confirm  compiles (no test files yet).

## Defensive rules
- setup.sh: abort if external/ has unexpected content (not a git repo) rather than silently overwriting
- setup.sh: record HEAD commit hash in audit/vector_commits.txt for reproducibility
- Cargo.toml: no wildcard feature flags; list each feature explicitly
- common.rs: wolfcrypt_init must be called before any test; add a once_cell or std::sync::Once guard so it is called exactly once per test binary
- #![forbid(unsafe_code)] at crate root (all test code is safe Rust)
- WOLFSSL_DIR must be set or cargo check will fail to link; document this in README snippet

## Agent team
- Agent R: read wolfssl-wolfcrypt/Cargo.toml to verify feature names; read build.rs to understand WOLFSSL_DIR env var
- Agent I: write all files per algorithm above
- Agent T: run cargo check to confirm compilation; run setup.sh --dry-run; inspect testvectors/ for completeness

## Tests
- cargo check with no test files passes
- setup.sh idempotency: run twice, second run produces no errors and no duplicate dirs
- aes_38a.rs hex literals parse without panic (no typos)
- cmac_38b.rs hex literals parse without panic
